description: Test suite for outbound media validation and resolution functions for LINE platform integration.

methods.name: validateLineMediaUrl
methods.description: Validates that the media URL uses HTTPS and is within length constraints.

methods.name: detectLineMediaKind
methods.description: Maps MIME types to media kinds (image, video, audio).

methods.description: Resolves and validates media URLs for LINE outbound messages, inferring media kind, verifying URLs, and handling media options.
